ApiUrl.Name: TableCodex API URL
ApiUrl.Hint: Base URL of your TableCodex instance (e.g. https://app.tablecodex.com).

ApiToken.Name: API Token
ApiToken.Hint: Your TableCodex API token. Found in TableCodex → Settings → Integrations.

WorldId.Name: Foundry World ID
WorldId.Hint: Automatically populated from the current world.

WorldName.Name: Foundry World Name
WorldName.Hint: Automatically populated from the current world.

CaptureWhispers.Name: Capture Whispers
CaptureWhispers.Hint: Include whispered chat messages in the session export. Default: off.

CapturePrivateRolls.Name: Capture Private Rolls
CapturePrivateRolls.Hint: Include GM-only and blind rolls in the session export. Default: off.

CaptureJournalText.Name: Capture Journal Text
CaptureJournalText.Hint: Include full journal page text in the session export. Default: off.

CaptureActorSnapshots.Name: Capture Actor Snapshots
CaptureActorSnapshots.Hint: Record actor summaries at session start/end and on creation/update.

CaptureItemSnapshots.Name: Capture Item Snapshots
CaptureItemSnapshots.Hint: Record item summaries at session start/end and on creation/update.

CaptureSceneSnapshots.Name: Capture Scene Snapshots
CaptureSceneSnapshots.Hint: Record scene info at session start/end.

AutoSync.Name: Auto-Sync on Session End
AutoSync.Hint: Automatically POST the session to TableCodex when you end it.

DebugLogging.Name: Debug Logging
DebugLogging.Hint: Log verbose capture events to the browser console.

Session.AlreadyActive: A TableCodex session is already active.
Session.NotActive: No TableCodex session is currently active.

EndSession.Title: End Session
EndSession.Content: End the current TableCodex session? You can still export or sync after ending.

ClearBuffer.Title: Clear Session Buffer
ClearBuffer.Content: This will permanently delete the current session buffer. This cannot be undone.

Notify.SessionResumed: TableCodex: Resumed active session from before reload.
Notify.SessionPendingExport: TableCodex: You have an unsaved session ready to export or sync.

Warn.LargePayload: TableCodex: Session payload is large (>5 MB). Sync may be slow.
Warn.NoCampaignsFound: TableCodex: No campaigns found. Check your API URL and token.
Warn.NoCampaignSelected: Select a campaign from the list first.
Warn.NoCampaignForSession: No campaign selected. Select a campaign before syncing.

Error.NoApiUrl: TableCodex API URL is not configured.
Error.NoApiToken: TableCodex API token is not configured.
Error.NoCampaign: Select a TableCodex campaign before connecting.
